title: DMCA Policy
content:
Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA) Policy

We acknowledge that of others regarding all matters relating to intellectual property rights. The same is expected from our users. After reading this document, you will know what to do if you believe there is material on our website that you own the copyright to. 

This DMCA Policy will also state how to report an alleged infringement of copyrights. It also outlines what will be done when we receive such notice. We respect all policies and requirements of the DMCA, and it is our policy to quickly respond to any copyright infringement claims.

DMCA Notification Form: If you are a copyright owner or have permission to act on behalf of a copyright owner, then you can go for this notice. Your notice must include the following information to be valid under the DMCA:

Your contact information. Put your name, address, phone number and email address.

A clear hopeful declaration regarding the subject matter that you have copyrights in; That you are sure of has been infringed. A very good example should be given so that we can distinguish the work in question.

A company description of the location of the infringing material on the website owned or operated by the company. Please provide a URL or any other information that allows us to find the content you use.

A statement that you have a good-faith belief that the use of other material is not approved by the copyright department, copyright holder or under the law license.

A statement to the effect that the information contained in your notice is true. Make sure that you are the copyright owner or somebody who the copyright owner designates.

If you want to send your DMCA notice in, there is an agent provided below to do so. Ensuring your notice meets all the elements is very crucial. Undetailed notice may cause a delay in the processing.

Response to DMCA Notices 

Once we receive a valid DMCA notice, we will review it carefully. If the notice meets the requirements, we will take appropriate action. It may include removing or disabling access to the allegedly infringing material. We may also contact the user who uploaded the content to inform them of the claim.

If the content is removed, the user who posted it can file a counter-notice. If they do, we will notify the copyright owner and may restore the content unless a court order is filed to prevent this. We strive to handle these situations fairly and comply with all legal obligations.

Repeat Infringers 

We are very concerned about repeat infringement. Any user found wanting in violation of any of these copyright laws or the adopted DMCA Policy will have the account terminated after several violations. 

It is to ensure the rights of the owners of the content delivered in our platform are well protected. When we find that a user is a repeat infringer, we will close that person’s account along with all of the material the user has posted. This action is the last; there can be no compromise or negotiation.

Liability Exemptions

 

We strive to protect ourselves from liability for violating the provisions of DMCA but do not assume any responsibility for content created by users. All content posted on our website is not censored. Please contact us today if you have complaints as we don’t allow any infringements of copyrights.

The necessary action will be taken where stipulated by law. However, we shall not be held responsible for any damages that result from prohibited content that may appear on this website except where, by law, it is compulsory.

DMCA Contact Information 

Suppose you have any questions regarding the implementation of this DMCA. We are here to ensure that all copyright issues are solved effectively and as much as possible with fairness. Contact information of our designated agent is provided above. We want to say that we are working on a timely response to all inquiries.
